_note: Static wiki reference data for the planned Reminders feature (birthday calendar). Not memory-derived -- unrelated to data/pointer_map.md. Confirmed accurate against the wiki. 'id' is the game's own confirmed Internal ID (data/pointer_map.md's 'NPC/Villager relationship struct' section / Harvest Sprite struct section) -- the same numbering for regular villagers and the 7 Harvest Sprites now (unified; previously two different schemes -- see data/tables/character_viewer.json's own history). 'season'/'day' are null for characters with no fixed birthday per the wiki. 'url' is each villager's individual stratswiki page (for a clickable name in the UI). 'loved_forage'/'loved_ingredients' are text fields (comma-separated item names, not arrays) pulled from each villager's gift table: 'loved_forage' is their Loves row's 'Forage:' list verbatim; 'loved_ingredients' is whichever of their Loves row's 'Miscellaneous:' items also appear in general_store_ingredients.json's COOKING_INGREDIENTS. If a villager has neither (no loved forage AND no loved purchasable ingredient), both fields instead pull from the Likes row and are prefixed '(Liked Only) '; if still nothing, the field is an empty string. The 7 Harvest Sprites' own wiki page lists their Loves-Miscellaneous items partly as generic category words ('Flour', 'Special Apples', 'Jewelry', 'Gems') rather than itemized names -- only literal exact-name matches (e.g. Aqua's 'Bread' and 'Dango Flour', both spelled out separately from the generic 'Flour' entry) were counted toward loved_ingredients; the generic category words were not expanded/guessed into specific ingredient names.
